# Shrimply

Shrimply is shrimp farm management software for vannamei farms and aquaculture teams. The platform helps farms track pond performance, feed inventory, water quality, growth sampling, harvests, finance, assets, disease alerts, and Orson AI insights in one operating system.

## Audience

Shrimply is built for shrimp farm owners, managers, technicians, and aquaculture teams that need cleaner operational data, better feed decisions, stronger reporting, and earlier risk visibility.
